title: ResizeableSubtitles
description: Resize, move, and customize Minecraft's subtitles from a clean in-game menu with a live preview
body:
[![JOIN OUR DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN%20OUR%20DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA)

A client-side mod that gives you full control over Minecraft's subtitles. Resize them, move them anywhere on screen, and adjust their opacity — with smart auto-alignment that keeps them neatly placed no matter the scale or your resolution.

![Tiny and tidy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2c1931a3d1d37794ec5b81765dff01b6e6c5814_0.webp)

**Client-side only** (no server installation required). **Fully compatible with singleplayer and multiplayer**.

**Please report any bugs, errors, or feature suggestions on Discord:** [https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE](https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE)

**What you can customize:**
- **Scale** your subtitles from `50%` to `300%`.
- **Opacity** from `20%` to `100%`.
- **Auto-align** them to the right, center, or left edge — so enlarged subtitles never clip off the screen (or switch it off for fully manual placement).
- **Position** them freely with horizontal and vertical offsets.
- A **live, scale-accurate preview** shows exactly how your subtitles will look while you tweak them.

**Usage:**
Open the settings from the mod-list config button, the `/resizeablesubtitles` command, or a bindable hotkey.

**Details:**
- All settings are stored locally in your client folder (`config/resizeablesubtitles.json`).
- Requires subtitles to be enabled in Minecraft's accessibility settings (Show Subtitles).
- Fully translated into 10 languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, and Italian.
